title: Correlation-Aware Evidential Fusion for Trusted Multi-View Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.33900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trusted multi-view classification aims to make accurate and reliable predictions by integrating information from multiple views. Existing methods typically estimate class evidence and uncertainty for each view and combine the resulting opinions through aggregation rules. However, they generally treat different views as independent information sources, overlooking the correlations among them. Highly correlated views tend to produce similar evidence, and treating them as independent sources may repeatedly count consistent information and give it disproportionate influence, while weakening complementary evidence that provides additional information. Consequently, such correlation-unaware fusion may not only limit classification performance but also produce miscalibrated uncertainty estimates. translated_title: 面向可信多视图分类的相关性感知证据融合
translated_abstract: 可信多视图分类旨在通过整合来自多个视图的信息，做出准确且可靠的预测。现有方法通常为每个视图估计类别证据和不确定性，并通过聚合规则组合由此产生的观点。然而，这些方法通常将不同视图视为独立的信息源，忽略了视图之间的相关性。高度相关的视图往往会产生相似的证据，将它们视为独立信息源可能会重复计算一致的信息并赋予其不成比例的影响力，同时削弱提供额外信息的互补性证据。因此，这种不考虑相关性的融合不仅可能限制分类性能，还可能产生校准不佳的不确定性估计。为解决这一问题，我们提出了相关性感知证据融合（CAFE）框架，用于可信多视图分类。CAFE通过对……
tldr: 提出了相关性感知证据融合框架CAFE，通过显式建模视图间的相关性，避免重复计算冗余证据、强化互补信息，从而提升可信多视图分类的性能和不确定性估计的校准质量。
